🧪 Live demo: a simulated 16-table restaurant running entirely in your browser. No camera and no server. The installed version connects to your existing CCTV.

Camera setup

In the installed version, this page shows a snapshot from your CCTV camera. You click around each table to draw its zone and click on a waiter's shirt to teach TableSense your uniform colour.

It needs a connected camera or video, so it isn't part of this browser-only demo.
